ordered_diagnoses: Fetal growth restriction due to placental insufficiency

s1.syndrome_frame: Complicated twin pregnancy with growth restriction and preeclampsia
key_facts: 34-year-old gravida 2, para 1 woman
Spontaneous dichorionic diamniotic twin pregnancy
Dichorionicity confirmed on first-trimester ultrasound
Growth restriction in twin 2 at 16 weeks
Anhydramnios and absent bladder in twin 2 at 16 weeks
Tetralogy of Fallot in twin 2 confirmed at 19 weeks
Normal chromosomal microarray in twin 2
Preeclampsia diagnosed at 30 weeks
Estimated fetal weight of twin 1 at 32 weeks: 1904g (62nd centile)
Estimated fetal weight of twin 2 at 32 weeks: 1128g (<5th centile)
Middle cerebral artery peak systolic velocity (MCA-PSV) of twin 1: 26 cm/s
Middle cerebral artery peak systolic velocity (MCA-PSV) of twin 2: 50.9 cm/s
Placental imaging showed thickened, echogenic placenta for twin 2

shortlist: Fetal growth restriction due to placental insufficiency

shortlist.label: Twin anemia-polycythemia sequence
shortlist.why_kept: Elevated MCA-PSV in twin 2 and thickened placenta suggest this condition

shortlist.label: Selective intrauterine growth restriction
shortlist.why_kept: Growth restriction in twin 2 with normal amniotic fluid and abnormal placental imaging

shortlist.label: Tetralogy of Fallot
shortlist.why_kept: Confirmed congenital heart disease in twin 2

shortlist.label: Fetal growth restriction due to placental insufficiency
shortlist.why_kept: Abnormal placental imaging and growth restriction in twin 2

raw.rationale: The presence of a significant difference in MCA-PSV between the two twins (26 cm/s in twin 1 vs 50.9 cm/s in twin 2), along with the growth restriction and thickened, echogenic placenta in twin 2, supports the diagnosis of twin anemia-polycythemia sequence.

rejected.label: Selective intrauterine growth restriction
rejected.why: While growth restriction is present in twin 2, the key finding of differing MCA-PSV values between the twins points more specifically to twin anemia-polycythemia sequence.

rejected.label: Preeclampsia
rejected.why: Preeclampsia is a complication of the pregnancy but does not directly explain the differences in fetal growth and MCA-PSV between the twins.

rejected.label: Tetralogy of Fallot
rejected.why: Tetralogy of Fallot is a congenital heart defect in twin 2 but does not account for the differences in growth and MCA-PSV between the twins.

rejected.label: Fetal growth restriction due to placental insufficiency
rejected.why: While placental insufficiency could contribute to growth restriction, the specific pattern of findings, including the difference in MCA-PSV, is more indicative of twin anemia-polycythemia sequence.
